svg.title: F01: choose existing nodes, issue one request, audit each GU method
svg.desc: An attacker-view-conditioned red-team Selector chooses existing eligible nodes. The input graph is shared by the IM coverage OR IF sensitivity selection routes. OR denotes alternative selection rules, not mutually exclusive access permissions. A deletion-request document preserves all node positions and marks only S. The graph is not poisoned or modified; no nodes are added. The same request S fans out to trained GU methods M1 through Mm and full retraining. Each method row aligns utility U_M, retrain gap G_M and excess gap E_M. Same-request full retraining and same-budget Random are separate references. All outputs are symbolic; no results, rankings or evaluation feedback to the Selector are shown.
